evidence.says: esv::combat::CombatantKilledSystem::ProcessDeaths (EoCServer.dll+0x149A060; query Spec<Participant, Death | optional eoc::PlayerComponent | added Death>) writes esv::combat::CombatantKilledEventOneFrameComponent +0 = the dying entity. EoCServer.dll+0x83FE70 (notification lambda, variant tag 6 = CombatantKilledNotificationRequest) turns event +0 into its Guid (FUN_180367e90) at request +0; dispatcher bg3.exe+0x2DF53B0 case 6 copies request +0..+0x22 straight into this component (creator bg3.exe+0x2DF4690, TypeIndex CombatantKilledNotificationComponent). The combatant that died.

ProcessDeaths EoCServer.dll+0x149A060 writes event +8 = DeathComponent +0 (death::DeathData::Cause); EoCServer.dll+0x83FE70 turns it into its Guid at request +0x10 (Empty Guid when the handle is invalid); bg3.exe+0x2DF53B0 case 6 copies it to +0x10. Named after DeathData::Cause: the entity that caused the death.

ProcessDeaths EoCServer.dll+0x149A060 writes event +0x10 = (the query's optional eoc::PlayerComponent of the dying entity is present); copied through request (EoCServer.dll+0x83FE70, 3 bytes) and bg3.exe+0x2DF53B0 case 6 to +0x20. Read as a flag by ecl::GameplaySoundSystem::ProcessCombatMusicNotifications (EoCClient.dll+0xE39BB0).

ProcessDeaths EoCServer.dll+0x149A060 writes event +0x11 = HasComponent(DeathData::Cause, eoc::PlayerComponent) (type index DAT_1821f166c, registered by EoCServer.dll+0x156D0 with GetTypeName<eoc::PlayerComponent>); copied through the request to +0x21. ProcessCombatMusicNotifications branches on it.

ProcessDeaths EoCServer.dll+0x149A060 writes event +0x12 = true when eoc::relation::IsEnemy(Cause (or the dying entity when Cause is invalid), p) holds for some participant p != the dying entity of eoc::CombatHelpers::GetCombatParticipants(dying entity's combat); copied through the request to +0x22. ProcessCombatMusicNotifications picks its sound event first on this byte.
